concepts.def: Story in the mind during sleep
Brain makes sense of random signals
Dreams help sort and store memories

walkthroughs.body_html:
Most vivid dreams happen in REM sleep.

Your eyes flicker, but your body is mostly paralysed — so you don't act them out. 👁️

Three theories:

  • Activation-synthesis — brain stitches a story from random signals.
  • Memory theory — dreams help file the day's memories.
  • Problem-solving — dreams chew on issues.

Nightmares are common, especially when stressed.

Lucid dreams — you realise you're dreaming. Some people can control them.

Most dreams fade within 10 minutes of waking. ☁️
